title: Salt Orris held at the collarbone

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. A close beauty crop from her lips to her collarbone: she presses the flacon lightly against her collarbone with two fingertips, the clear glass cold on her skin, the label turned to camera. She wears a black silk shirt open at the collar. Soft north light from a large window on the left, a gentle fill, her skin with real texture and a faint sheen. 100mm at f/4, focus on the label, her chin and lips just soft at the top of the frame.
